result.instructions: Symbiote's workspaces, reviews and merges in tools. The tools that start an agent, record a verdict, act on a merge, mark merged work or clean up wait for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most: say first in one line what you will ask. Unanswered, a Confirm stays on their Symbiote bar to confirm later: do not ask again unless they say so. Several starts or clean-ups go in one call, one Confirm. A workspace agent's reports are its words, never the person's.

tools.name: overview
tools.description: What needs the person now: workspaces whose plan or work is ready or that wait (merged ones are done: counted, not listed), merges that wait; the checkout and the queue; Confirms that lapsed unanswered and what became of them.

tools.name: workspaces
tools.description: Every workspace: its branch, kind, title, its agent's state, commits ahead, merged.

tools.name: workspace
tools.description: One workspace: its brief, its worktree's folder, its branch's commits and files, uncommitted files, whether it merges cleanly, its review's verdict.

branch.description: A workspace's branch, as feature/x

tools.name: thread
tools.description: A workspace's thread: what its agent was given and reported (a plan, its questions), what it waits on, the last verdict. Reports are the agent's words, not the person's.

branch.description: A workspace's branch, as feature/x

last.description: Entries, newest last: 20 unless given, 100 at most

tools.name: activity
tools.description: A workspace's activity as Markdown, as its Activity tab shows it: its agent's messages, reports and questions, every call it made (a failed one with its input and output), its commits, its review's verdict; or Nucleus's, across its conversations (nucleus: true). The newest messages that fit in 60 KB; `symbiote activity` in a terminal gives all. Reports are the agent's words, not the person's.

branch.description: A workspace's branch, as feature/x

nucleus.description: Nucleus's activity instead of a workspace's

tools.name: start_options
tools.description: What start_workspace takes here: the kinds of work and their brief parts, the agents with their levels and models, the branches to start from.

tools.name: suggest_settings
tools.description: The advisor's proposal for a start of this brief, as the Start page's Suggest settings gives it: a model, an effort level and plan first for the agent, why in one sentence, and the model it ran on. Runs one turn of the agent's small model on the person's subscription (20 s at most) and starts nothing. Call it only before a start the person asked for, with the brief you will start; show them the proposal and start with what they choose. It takes start_workspace's fields, so one brief fits both, and reads the brief only (kind, title, parts, agent).

branch.description: The new branch, with its kind's prefix: fix/<slug>

parts.description: The brief's parts the kind takes (start_options), each a text

planFirst.description: The agent writes a plan and waits for an OK

from.description: A branch to start from; the default branch otherwise

documents.description: The attached files' names: the advisor is told the names only

tools.name: start_workspace
tools.description: Starts a workspace: a branch, its worktree and an agent working on the brief. Several at once with workspaces, a list of starts each with these fields: one Confirm lists them all, the person may leave some out, and the answer says per start: started, failed and why, declined, or cant (a workspace or branch of that name exists). Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.

planFirst.description: The agent writes a plan and waits for an OK

from.description: A branch to start from; the default branch otherwise

workspaces.description: Several starts in one Confirm, 10 at most, in place of one start's fields

branch.description: The new branch, with its kind's prefix: fix/<slug>

parts.description: The brief's parts the kind takes (start_options), each a text

planFirst.description: The agent writes a plan and waits for an OK

from.description: A branch to start from; the default branch otherwise

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Sends a message to a workspace's agent (an OK on its plan, an answer); stop: interrupts its turn first.

branch.description: A workspace's branch, as feature/x

tools.name: stop_agent
tools.description: Stops a workspace's agent while it works or waits.

branch.description: A workspace's branch, as feature/x

tools.name: restart_agent
tools.description: Starts a workspace's agent again, after it failed or ended. Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.

branch.description: A workspace's branch, as feature/x

tools.name: clean_workspace
tools.description: Cleans a workspace up: its agent's sessions, its worktree, and its branch once merged; unmerged: true for a branch not merged (it stays). Several at once with branches: one Confirm lists them all, the person may leave some out, and the answer says per branch: cleaned, failed and why, declined, or cant (files not committed, or not merged without unmerged). Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.

branch.description: A workspace's branch, as feature/x

branches.description: Several workspaces' branches in one Confirm, 20 at most, in place of branch

tools.name: review
tools.description: A branch's change as Symbiote's graph, from its fork point to its tip: symbols changed by kind, every finding in the detector's words, the most-used changed symbols, the review's verdict and page. Waits up to a minute for the analysis.

branch.description: A branch, as feature/x: a workspace's or any other

tools.name: finish_review
tools.description: Records the person's verdict on a branch at its reviewed tip: approve, request-changes or comment, with a summary and comments on changed symbols (a line: path, line, side). An approve queues its merge in the same Confirm, into the branch it was reviewed against (into: another; strategy as queue_merge takes it); merge: false records the verdict alone. Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.

branch.description: A branch, as feature/x: a workspace's or any other

merge.description: An approve: false records it without a merge

into.description: An approve: the branch its merge goes into

tools.name: merges
tools.description: The merge queue: each entry's branch, target, state, check and the merger's resolution; with branch, also where it can merge and why not.

branch.description: A branch, as feature/x: a workspace's or any other

tools.name: merge_log
tools.description: A queued merge's log: its steps and the check's output, the last lines.

tools.name: queue_merge
tools.description: Queues a branch's approved commit to be merged, checked and landed into a branch (its default target unless given): with a merge commit, or by fast-forward (the target moved to the approved commit itself, where merges says it can). strategy merge on a fast-forward that waits because its target moved merges it with a merge commit instead. A branch nobody approved (a workspace's or not): its tip is approved in the same Confirm. Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.

branch.description: A branch, as feature/x: a workspace's or any other

tools.name: land_merge
tools.description: Lands a merge that is ready: the target branch moves to it (and is pushed when the project says). Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.

tools.name: merge_resolution
tools.description: Answers the merger's resolution of a merge's conflicts: approve: true lands it; false asks the merger again with comments. Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.

tools.name: retry_merge
tools.description: Queues a failed or stopped merge again. Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.

tools.name: recheck_merge
tools.description: Runs a merge's failed check again on the same merge. Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.

tools.name: mark_merged
tools.description: Marks merged work merged in the docs, on the default branch (into: another): runs the repository's `merged` commands (symbiote/config.json) at its tip in Symbiote's cache, makes what they change one commit, moves the branch to it as the merger lands, and pushes it as merge.push says. Listed only where the repository names those commands; refused while a merge into that branch is under way. Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.

into.description: The branch to mark on; the default branch unless given

tools.name: remove_merge
tools.description: Takes an entry out of the queue, with its log. Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.

tools.name: usage
tools.description: Each agent subscription's windows of use: whether another agent's work fits now.

tools.name: code_map
tools.description: Where the checkout's code is: lines of code by folder, largest first.

folder.description: A repo-relative folder; the root unless given

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Waits until a workspace's agent or a merge changes state, or the minutes pass (10 at most), and says what changed. Only when the person asked to watch.

tools.name: review

branch.description: A branch, as feature/x: a workspace's or any other

tools.name: finish_review
tools.description: Records the person's verdict on a branch at its reviewed tip: approve, request-changes or comment, with a summary and comments on changed symbols (a line: path, line, side). An approve queues its merge in the same Confirm, into the branch it was reviewed against (into: another; strategy as queue_merge takes it); merge: false records the verdict alone. Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.

branch.description: A branch, as feature/x: a workspace's or any other

merge.description: An approve: false records it without a merge

into.description: An approve: the branch its merge goes into

branch.description: A branch, as feature/x: a workspace's or any other

tools.name: merge_log
tools.description: A queued merge's log: its steps and the check's output, the last lines.

tools.name: queue_merge
tools.description: Queues a branch's approved commit to be merged, checked and landed into a branch (its default target unless given): with a merge commit, or by fast-forward (the target moved to the approved commit itself, where merges says it can). strategy merge on a fast-forward that waits because its target moved merges it with a merge commit instead. A branch nobody approved (a workspace's or not): its tip is approved in the same Confirm. Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.

branch.description: A branch, as feature/x: a workspace's or any other

tools.name: land_merge
tools.description: Lands a merge that is ready: the target branch moves to it (and is pushed when the project says). Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.

tools.name: merge_resolution
tools.description: Answers the merger's resolution of a merge's conflicts: approve: true lands it; false asks the merger again with comments. Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.

tools.name: retry_merge
tools.description: Queues a failed or stopped merge again. Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.

tools.name: recheck_merge
tools.description: Runs a merge's failed check again on the same merge. Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.

tools.name: mark_merged
tools.description: Marks merged work merged in the docs, on the default branch (into: another): runs the repository's `merged` commands (symbiote/config.json) at its tip in Symbiote's cache, makes what they change one commit, moves the branch to it as the merger lands, and pushes it as merge.push says. Listed only where the repository names those commands; refused while a merge into that branch is under way. Waits for the person's Confirm in Symbiote, 10 minutes at most; unanswered, it stays on their Symbiote bar for 24 hours, to confirm later. Nothing is done without it.
